seoTitle: Wichita Public Schools Calendar 2026–27: Dates & PDFs
seoDescription: Wichita Public Schools starts Aug. 13, 2026, and ends May 25, 2027. See WPS breaks, no-school days, conferences, grading periods, and official calendar PDFs.
heroSummary: Wichita Public Schools starts classes Thursday, August 13, 2026, and the last day of school is Tuesday, May 25, 2027. Fall Recess runs November 24–27, Student Winter Recess runs December 21–January 4, and Spring Recess runs March 15–19. Students in grades 6–12 who are new to their building attend orientation on August 12.
heroSourceLine: Based on the official WPS 2026–27 School Year Calendar, revised May 13, 2026

calendarNotes: WPS lists August 13 as the first student day and May 25 as the last. Student Winter Recess runs December 21–January 4; the shorter December 24–January 1 range shows when district administrative offices are closed. January 4 is a District Inservice Day, and the calendar expressly lists January 5 as the student return date. WPS standardizes parent-teacher conference dates districtwide and separately identifies the conference day with no school, the next nonteaching day, and later Conference Release Days. The PDF lists 172 contact days across four grading periods. Kindergarten opening attendance is assigned by each school and is not represented as a separate districtwide date here.
keyDatesSummarySubtitle: Start and end dates, major breaks, and the January 5 return to class

gradingPeriodsDescription: The official calendar lists 172 contact days across four grading periods.

customSections.label: Two Winter Recess Ranges Appear on the WPS Calendar
customSections.content: For student attendance, use the longer Student Winter Recess: December 21 through January 4. The shorter December 24–January 1 range shows when district administrative offices are closed. January 4 is also a District Inservice Day, and students return Tuesday, January 5.

table.caption: How the two WPS Winter Recess ranges differ
rows: Students return to class after winter recess and the Jan. 4 inservice day

customSections.label: How WPS Conference Dates Affect Attendance
customSections.content: WPS sets parent-teacher conference dates districtwide. The calendar distinguishes the conference window from the no-school conference day, the following Nonteaching Duty Day, and later Conference Release Days. Schools set individual appointment times.

customSections.label: WPS Revised the November 2026 Schedule
customSections.content: WPS approved changes to the November 2026 schedule in February 2026. The current calendar lists November 3 as a District Inservice Day, November 23 as a Conference Release Day, and November 24 as the Veterans Day observance. November 11 is a regular school day. These updates create the published Fall Recess from November 24 through November 27. Families using an older copy may see different November dates, so use the current PDF linked on this page.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Wichita Public Schools students return after Winter Recess?
calendarFaqs.a: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Student Winter Recess runs through January 4, and January 4 is also a District Inservice Day.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does the WPS calendar show two Winter Recess ranges?
calendarFaqs.a: December 21–January 4 is Student Winter Recess. The shorter December 24–January 1 range shows when district administrative offices are closed.

calendarFaqs.q: When are WPS parent-teacher conferences in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The districtwide conference ranges are October 13–15, 2026, and March 9–11, 2027. Students have no school on October 15 and March 11; schools provide appointment times.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a WPS Conference Release Day?
calendarFaqs.a: WPS explains that a Conference Release Day recognizes evening hours worked during parent-teacher conferences. Students do not attend on the published release day.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all Wichita kindergarten students attend school on August 13?
calendarFaqs.a: August 13 is WPS's districtwide first day of school, but kindergarteners have scheduled attendance days during the first few days. Families should follow the schedule provided by their school.

calendarFaqs.q: Are the Spanish and Vietnamese calendars different schedules?
calendarFaqs.a: No. They are official language versions of the same WPS 2026–27 school-year calendar and are linked in Downloads.
